head: codex/5911-fastwork-storage-policy
title: Enforce FastWork worktrees and archive Codex sessions safely
body:
## Summary

- require all new ADL issue worktrees beneath `/Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees` through typed v2 binding
- preserve idempotent recovery for already-bound matching legacy worktrees
- add a non-destructive Codex-session archive tool with SHA-256 verification, owner-only permissions, and symlink/path escape refusal
- archive and independently verify 6,454 inactive transcript files totaling 131,750,498,984 bytes on FastWork
- repair all standalone C-SDLC bind fixtures to use truthful linked-worktree topology

## Validation

- exact-head hosted `cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml`: PASS (run 31561244618)
- `bash adl/tools/test_archive_codex_sessions_to_fastwork.sh`: PASS
- strict Clippy with warnings denied: PASS
- independent verification of the complete FastWork archive manifest: PASS
- exact-head subagent review: no actionable findings

No source transcripts or existing worktrees were deleted or relocated. Deletion remains separately approval-gated.

Related operational tracker: #246

Closes #5911
